note: Corps of Engineers campground on two wooded points of Pomme de Terre Lake south of Wheatland, with a sandy swim beach, boat ramp, courtesy dock and playground between them. The smaller east loop (sites 75-82) is on an open, lightly treed point with pads close above the water; the tip of the west loop (22, 23, 27, 30) is the same. October and November are a limited season with electricity only, and it does not run every year. Check in at the attendant booth; cards only. --Claude

flags: LIVE: facility 233672 is active, 41 campsites 'Open', the 2027 calendar loaded from April 16 with reservations already on it.

SEASON - NOTICE AND CALENDAR DISAGREE: the notice reads 'There is no limited Camping Season this Fall/Winter in Wheatland Park. During the off-season, there is a limited camping season that only has electricity available. $10 per night, Dates: March 15 - April 15, October 1 - November 30.' The calendar has NO nights in November 2026 (so the limited season is not running this fall) and none in March or early April 2027, but it does carry October 1 - November 30, 2027, and the rate table prices those nights at $16, not $10. Written from the calendar (Apr 16 - Nov 30, the live calendar outranking the notice); the note says the limited season does not run every year. If the owner would rather the season end Sep 30 (the only part certain every year), that is the alternative. The stored season was 'not year-round' with no dates.

RATES: Peak $26 on every site by its fee template (the rate table calls it 'ELECTRIC & WATER'). The table also holds a $24 'ELECTRIC (BASIC)' peak template, which reads as the price for the electric-only sites, but no site record uses it in peak - the five no-water sites carry the $26 template in peak and the 'basic' one only off-peak ($16 either way). So $24 is unconfirmed and left out. Non-Peak $16 (2027). The notice's '$10 per night' for the limited season is not in the rate table. The $16 non-electric and tent-only templates belong to no site here.

ELECTRIC-ONLY SITES - FACILITY TEXT VS SITE RECORDS: the text says '35 campsites with electric and water hookups and 6 sites with electric hookups only'. The per-site records show 36 with water and 5 without (01, 04, 51, 57, 60 - the sites along the entrance road at the north end). The search catalog disagrees with the per-site records again on four of those (it shows Water Hookup 'Yes' on 01, 04, 51, 57). The off-peak fee templates mark exactly 01, 04, 51, 57, 60 as 'basic', which supports five.
AMPERAGE: per-site records: 50 A on 11 sites, 30 A on 30. Stored 50 stands; the facility text gives no amperage.
MINIMUM STAY: minWeekendStay 2 (weekend, not standing - no drop question) and minHolidayWeekendStay 3; both written.

NO FIRST-COME: stored booking had no fcfs value; the notices say every site is by reservation, bookable same-day ('Reservation tags will no longer be posted ... it is the camper's responsibility to check if a campsite has been reserved'). 'Cash and checks will no longer be accepted.'

DOUBLE PEDESTALS / EXTRA UNITS: 'Campsites 18, 25, 28, 29, 31, and 82 have two pedestals. The second pedestal acts as another campsite, can only be used if the campground is full, and must be purchased separately.' and 'Additional fees will be charged for additional camping units' - no amount posted, nothing written.

WATERFRONT LEAD - LAKEFRONT LOOKS EARNED (stored lakeview; not written): leaf-off imagery, lake at a normal-looking pool (narrow bare rim). East loop: the pads of 77, 78 and 79 run west off the loop onto an open slope with a few scattered trees, pad ends about 25-35 m from the water with nothing between; 80 and 81 are about 30-40 m above the south shore, also open with scattered trees. West loop: 22, 27 and 30 at the tip are about 10-25 m from the water over open ground, 23 about 25 m. That is about nine pads on an open apron within ~50 m with nothing between them and the lake. The rest of the west loop (09-19, 24-26, 37) is 40-120 m back in timber, 68-74 are along the ramp road in cedars, and 01, 02, 04, 51, 57, 60 are 250-300 m from the lake at the entrance. No site record carries a Proximity to Water attribute.
